notes.title: Fishy Friday #4: Introducing Playsaurus!
notes.content: [p]Welcome to a very special edition of Fishy Friday. Today, I am happy to announce our partnership with [url="https://playsaurus.com/index.php"]Playsaurus[/url]! Playsaurus has a long history of creating and publishing idle games. They are the exact partner I need right now, and I am extremely excited about the possibilities they bring![/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/2f66bc8a2938391b33c982fe7def7999928b3ae3.png"][/img]What does this mean?[/h1][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/cc8134926b8343f36751f06986d7558e6cbfc46e.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/cc8134926b8343f36751f06986d7558e6cbfc46e.gif"][/img][/url][/p][p]In short, Black Hole Fishing just got an upgrade.[/p][list][*][p]Playsaurus [b]will[/b] be providing me with much needed support, including marketing, funding, QA, etc. They have been making idle games for years, and are able to help me get this project across the finish line.[/p][/*][*][p]Playsaurus [b]will not[/b] be changing the creative vision for the game. They are here to help, but they are a studio that respects the creative visions of their partners. I will be asking them for guidance and feedback, but ultimately, the design of the game remains my responsibility.[/p][/*][*][p]The release date [b]will[/b] be changing. To quote Miyamoto: "A delayed game is eventually good, a rushed game is bad forever" I was running out of resources, and was going to have to release the game before it was ready. This is no longer the case, and I can now promise that Black Hole Fishing will be a game worth playing when you finally get your hands on it.[/p][/*][*][p]Your feedback [b]will[/b] continue to matter to me/us. If you are a part of the community already, or you are waiting for those playtests to finally start (soon, I promise), then expect development to continue as it has been.[/p][/*][*][p]And, finally, I [b]will[/b] finally start posting more consistent development updates... [i]probably.[/i] I have a lot less gamedev-adjacent work to do now (marketing, various paperwork), so I have fewer excuses now. Stay tuned.[/p][/*][/list][p]Stay Fishy! (That's still terrible, but we're rolling with it...)[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Fishy Friday #3 - A Flood of Fancy Fish
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/652ee269dbd9a42773869dc211f29b976d53b04d.png"][/img][/h1][h1]Welcome to Fishy Friday #3 - A Flood of Fancy Fish[/h1][p]Welcome back to Fishy Friday! Apologies for the delay, I had a conference and a family vacation (two exciting things that don't make for a very exciting announcement). I'm back now - and working hard on Black Hole Fishing.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/7c7b232ac783987743823c441efa78ae11f6c727.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Fish lab update![/h2][p]If you haven't checked out the Fish Lab on Itch, now's a great time! I've updated it again, and there are now a total of 2.5 Septillion unique fish variants you can make![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/5cf7ea766dcc52df1844a17406f2976f8b3040ec.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://sdggames.itch.io/fish-lab" style="button"]Visit the Lab[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/cc8134926b8343f36751f06986d7558e6cbfc46e.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Why the lab matters:[/h2][p]Of course, the Fish Lab isn't a part of Black Hole Fishing. It's a superset - meaning it contains all of the possible fish breeding operations for the game itself. I'm now in the fortunate position where all of my planned features technically exist, but need to be exposed in-game. Of course, the fish don't do much as long as they're stuck in the lab.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/1622b36f618efc6e3ba9e15c2078d8d19f80b648.gif"][/img][/p][p]Good news: The fish have left the lab![/p][p]This new fish system is fully integrated in the base game, meaning you can see a much larger variety of fish in the game now. The demo is still (currently) limited to Cash Carp, but that will change soon.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/bcc3c9e23d38216a0d9d497e1f6251a480486882.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/26342aa4a2d833a26945611b30f6666c64eef64e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/0f68d204adac6bf25fffd097017f40804a0cb922.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/cfb41603a49b6eab7d27247f9b4836f99831a61a.png"][/img][/carousel][h2]"The Big Update"[/h2][p]All of this - the Fish Lab and the backend game systems rework - is a foundation for the features I foreshadowed in the first Fishy Friday. Hopefully, the next update will contain at least a few of these features.[/p][p]Of course, there are a lot of other exciting things happening behind the scenes, but I don't want to get too far ahead of myself. Games take time to develop, and I released the first demo very early. I'll share more news (and the next stages in my roadmap) once I have the first set of breeding systems in your hands. Thank you for being a part of this development journey! [/p][p][strike]Stay fishy![/strike] (No, that's terrible, I am not using that) Have... a good day.[/p]

notes.title: Fishy Friday the Fourth (of July): Founding the Fish Lab
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/652ee269dbd9a42773869dc211f29b976d53b04d.png"][/img][/p][h1]Welcome to Fishy Friday the Fourth (of July): Founding the Fish Lab[/h1][p]Today, we are diving in to the wonderful world of procedural fish! I have some good news, some bad news, and more good news and bad news.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/cc8134926b8343f36751f06986d7558e6cbfc46e.gif"][/img][/p][h2]About the demo.[/h2][p]Let's start with the bad news. I was going to release an updated version of the game's demo today, but I ended up taking the weekend off for the holiday. Which leads to the good news: There will be a [b]Special Edition[/b] of Fishy Friday next week which will include a major demo update! Keep your eyes out for that![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/7c7b232ac783987743823c441efa78ae11f6c727.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Now for the good news:[/h2][p]We at Fishy Business Co have been hard at work breeding and developing fish for the game. In fact, we just passed 69 BILLION fish variants produced! That's right - billion with a B.[/p][p][/p][p]Here is our latest masterpiece - specialty bred for the holiday. Say Hi to Murray the Murican Catfish![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/2ce395eb286a87fd303e7c48fe50cc888e989ac7.gif"][/img]Hi Murray.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/706f769a65db231c28a39377af027570e884d7f2.gif"][/img][/p][p](Ignore the torpedofish - he wasn't supposed to leave the lab)[/p][p][/p][h3]We have been breeding all of these fish in our brand new Fish Lab![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/8e0ba4da91aad726c7fcaf21ecc4e9204a03c855.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]About the Lab[/h2][p]The Fish lab is an experimental fish breeding operation. We can combine any shape fish with any color set, and mix in up to four genetic traits, including eye size, eye color, and pattern/texture. These are the fish that will be populating your point from here on out. We currently have a brand new set of Cash Carp on the way, and they should be in the Demo pond sometime next week.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/46a23067e07ec0a43a965fa68b67abe23b76d248.png"][/img][/p][p]Ok, it's time for more bad news. The lab... isn't for sale. I know, it looks cool, but we have so much specialty equipment that we couldn't [b]possibly[/b] ship all the way out to your little pond. We promise, the Fishy Business magazine will contain as many fish breeding and fish merging machines as possible.[/p][p]Black Hole Fishing is an incremental game, and that means unlocking things slowly. Just picking traits and putting them into a fish would totally kill the [i]gameplay[/i] :D Although, if you really want to try it out, we might be convinced to let you [b]visit[/b] the lab.[/p][p]An early experimental version just hit Itch.io, so feel free to mess around with the fish for yourself. This is a development tool, so don't expect a lot of polish. You can try it in your browser, though - no download required.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/7c7b232ac783987743823c441efa78ae11f6c727.gif"][/img][/p][h1][url="https://sdggames.itch.io/fish-lab" style="button"]Visit the Fish Lab[/url][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/cc8134926b8343f36751f06986d7558e6cbfc46e.gif"][/img][/p][p]That's all for this week![/p]

notes.title: Fishy Friday the First: Foreshadowing Forthcoming Features
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/652ee269dbd9a42773869dc211f29b976d53b04d.png"][/img][/p][h2]Welcome to Fishy Friday the First: Foreshadowing Forthcoming Features![/h2][p]Ok, I'll drop the alliteration (amusing and alluring as it may be). This week, we will be looking back at the first two months of development, and laying out a roadmap for the next few months.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/7c7b232ac783987743823c441efa78ae11f6c727.gif"][/img][/p][h3]The State of Things:[/h3][p]Black Hole Fishing has had a relatively short development cycle so far. I am planning on releasing the game before October (I am aiming for August, but will announce a fixed date a little later), so I decided to release an early demo for the Steam Next Fest in June.[/p][p]The response has been incredible, the game has been added to over 1000 wishlists already! With that said, I should clarify that the current demo is an early preview of the game, not a proper showcase of all the systems. I created a video documenting the past two months of development, so feel free to give it a watch if you're so inclined.[/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://(https://youtu.be/kElBrNwosrY)"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/cc8134926b8343f36751f06986d7558e6cbfc46e.gif"][/img][/h3][h3]The Science![/h3][p]So that's the current state of things. What's next?[/p][p]The current Next Fest demo features a liner progression cycle. You buy Super Stocker nodes, you place them in the pond, and then you upgrade the speed or fish value. The next major update will introduce the Super Stocker Pro. Instead of upgrading through 8 fish of increasing value, you will be able to buy one of a hundred fish from the magazine (don't worry, they will be sorted into sets and unlocked slowly. There will be time to digest all of the new colors, shapes, patterns, [i][b]Traits[/b][/i], and tradeoffs).[/p][p]Speaking of [i][b]Traits[/b][/i], the new system will also unlock bonus fish that use their traits to affect the world. This can synergize with other fish to create score bonuses, or cause [i]things[/i] to happen. Some fish are compatible with the Super Stocker Pro, but other fish must launched one at a time from a Fish Cannon.[/p][p]The magazine offers a limited selection of traits and visual stylings, so you will eventually want to start creating your own fish. The next game update will include the Fish Press, and more advances tools will come down the road. Keep an eye out for special editions of Fishy Friday where we deep-dive into each of these tools, and the [i][b]Traits[/b][/i] they will unlock.[/p][p]I'll pause to quote the store page here. These features may change a little as we go on, so consider this a time capsule as well as an update:[/p][list][*][p][b]Collect Fish:[/b] Buy fish from the Fishy Business Magazine. Put them in the pond. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Combine Fish:[/b] Shove two fish into the (extremely ethical) Fish Press to create a new fish! The new fish will contain Traits from [i]BOTH[/i] of the old fish. What a deal! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Breed Fish:[/b] Tired of losing fish to the press? Give two fish an intimate moment, and receive a [i]NEW FISH[/i] as a reward! [i]Warning[/i]: Cross-breeding will result in randomized traits, repeat until desired results are achieved. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Design Fish:[/b] Tired of waiting for the genetic lottery to pay out? Take the genomes into your own hands by directly injecting fish with Traits. Results almost guaranteed! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Collide Fish:[/b] Science isn't going to progress itself! Use the Large Halibut Collider to combine fish at relativistic speeds! Discover all six Quantum Sharks, and use them to progress our understanding of destructive singularities at an alarming rate! [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/7c7b232ac783987743823c441efa78ae11f6c727.gif"][/img][/p][h3]The Story![/h3][p]But how do we unlock all of this? I tested out a few story ideas: Maybe the magazine is an Eldritch god? Maybe the Fishy Business is run by a supervillain and you are his unwitting pawn. Ultimately, I decided that a good incremental story doesn't need a villain at all. Your goal is to become the world's greatest fisherman. Why not pair that noble goal with an equally noble goal: Becoming the world's greatest scientist![/p][p]You start the game with just the cover page of the Fishy Business magazine, unlocking the black hole and starting the game. As you progress, you gain the attention of the mad scientist who runs the Fishy Business. It turns out, he's too busy to leave the lab, so you are the perfect candidate to test out his inventions. Over the course of the campaign, he will send you letters - along with new pages for the Magazine. As you buy and upgrade your equipment, you help him prove his outlandish theories. Unfortunately, his excitement has a tendency to outweigh his caution, so his black hole experiments eventually turn apocalyptic. No worries![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/cc8134926b8343f36751f06986d7558e6cbfc46e.gif"][/img][/p][p]That's all for this week! Keep an eye out for future editions - released every other Friday until the game ships or the singularity destroys us all.[/p][p]P.S. Yes, I am proud of my Fish .gif page dividers. How can you tell?[/p][p]P.P.S. Also, I'm planning on starting playtesting in the next month or so. You can join my [url="https://discord.gg/EuD49zve3X"]Discord [/url]for more up-to-date information, or just hit the Follow button to get notified. I will make a big announcement, so you won't miss it.[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to Black Hole Fishing
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/853d83abab0cfc912e574fba1e2ae833b77cdff1.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome to Black Hole Fishing![/p][p]I just released the demo for the game for Next Fest. Actually, I stealth-launched the demo last week, but I didn't announce it until now. Thank you to the 425 people who found and played the demo anyways. I fixed (most of) the bugs, so if you played it before, now is a great time to play it again.[/p][p][/p][h2]Fishy Friday Facts (but on a Monday)[/h2][p]This is the beginning of the journey for Black Hole Fishing, so keep an eye out for updates going forwards. I'll share them on Fridays for alliterative reasons. To start us off, let's talk about the game art.[/p][p]Fun fact: the game doesn't actually have any art. I mean, technically, it [b]is[/b] art, but everything you see is made in Godot and [b]only[/b] Godot. No sprites, meshes, or anything else. This might be clearer if I show an early development screen shot:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/9eae2167694d2b66a3b2d0a4a2c6e74d6a6e3af8.png"][/img]You can really see the polygons in this one![/p][p][/p][p]I have been exploring the limits of this... limitation, and I'm quite proud of what I was able to accomplish. Here is the first iteration of the Fishy Business Magazine.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/2766d724bcb70bac727288c06568a098b71ee65b.png"][/img]I took inspiration from old Bass Pro Shops catalogs. The style might change a bit, but the idea is locked in. The game leans in to absurdist humor, but it plays on the tropes of cosmic horror. Who created this magazine, and why do they want to destroy the world. Could it be that the magazine is... alive? We will explore these themes in later updates.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll end this update with a couple more screen shots. These are currently on the store page, but I think future readers might be curious to see what the initial demo looked like.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/38501e97ae35ca460add1704e351f4de4f7e36d6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619975/f2ba46472819a6bde906181397d06ab9c3c4b870.png"][/img][/p][p]That is all for now! Keep an eye out for more Friday Fishy... Fun? Facts. We'll work on the name.[/p]
